svg.title: food_dw star schema
svg.desc: Two fact tables (fact_orders, fact_order_items) joined to six dimensions: dim_date, dim_customer, dim_payment_method, dim_restaurant, dim_delivery_partner, dim_menu_item.
svg.text: 2 fact tables · 6 dimensions · every foreign key indexed · MySQL 8

g.text: Grain: one row per item per order
